hero.body: People, service reports, S-21, schedules, duties and attendance — in one calm app that works on any phone.
truth.phone: Made for phones and large text.
how.title: A little preparation. A calmer week.
how.1.title: Add your people
how.1.body: Paste a spreadsheet or add publishers one by one.
how.2.title: Prepare the month
how.2.body: Collect reports, download S-21 records, and choose people for the week’s assignments.
how.3.title: Share your way
how.3.body: A protected link, your sharing app, or a PDF.
features.title: The tools you reach for, together.
feature.s21.title: S-21 in one tap
feature.s21.body: Download beside a publisher, or choose everyone, pioneers, elders, ministerial servants, SFTS, or publishers with missing reports.
feature.reports.title: Reports without chasing
feature.reports.body: Group links, household reporting, and reminders you send yourself.
feature.meetings.title: The week’s parts, already there
feature.meetings.body: English meeting parts arrive from wol.jw.org. You choose who will give each part.
feature.fair.title: Fair suggestions
feature.fair.body: See who was last used, find someone not used yet, and review fill-empty auto-assignment.
feature.weekend.title: Weekend meetings
feature.weekend.body: Talks, speakers, and a heads-up when a talk number was last given.
feature.s89.title: S-89 slips
feature.s89.body: Download an assignment for the student and assistant, or share the PDF yourself.
feature.duties.title: Duties
feature.duties.body: Audio Video, Attendants, and Cleaning use people the administrator approves.
feature.attendance.title: Attendance from the door
feature.attendance.body: The meeting date and type come from your congregation’s calendar and timezone.
feature.assistant.title: On-device assistant
feature.assistant.body: Type it the way you’d say it. Your words stay on your device; confirmed records save through the app.
feature.themes.title: Themes and comfort
feature.themes.body: Nine themes, larger text, and layouts that adapt to your phone.
security.title: Clear answers before you trust us.
security.who.a: One independent developer you can email.
security.access.a: Your approved users, within their assigned roles. In Standard mode, the service operator can technically access server-stored records.
security.protection.a: Encrypted connections, database access rules, scoped public links, and tests. Private mode stays unavailable until full encryption tests pass.
pricing.title: Simple plans for a congregation.
pricing.founding: Everything is free until 1 May 2027. Starter stays free forever.
pricing.current: Annual congregation access is ₹1,499. There is no automatic charge. Contact support to arrange access or renewal.
faq.title: A few things you might wonder.
faq.1.a: No. Congregation Assistant is independent and unofficial, with no JW logos or affiliation with any religious organization.
faq.2.a: Approved members see records allowed by their roles. In Standard mode, the service operator can technically access the database. Security & Trust explains the boundaries.
faq.3.a: Private mode is unavailable until the full encryption tests pass. Current congregation records use Standard mode.
faq.4.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.4.a: The app works in a browser. Install app first tries your browser’s prompt, then shows instructions for your device.
faq.5.a: Previously loaded records and supported midweek drafts work offline. The app shows pending edits and syncs them when you reconnect. Other tools need a connection; watch the save status.
faq.6.q: Can a household share one email?
faq.6.a: Linked household publishers can use the household reporting flow. Your administrator sets up the relationship and account access.
faq.7.q: What happens when the free period ends?
faq.7.a: Check your workspace’s plan and expiry date. There is no automatic charge. Contact support about access, renewal, and the records you need to keep.
faq.8.q: Can I export or delete my data?
faq.8.a: Administrators can download record exports and recovery backups from Settings. Contact support for workspace deletion. Keep exports private and check that you can open them.
faq.9.a: V4 launches in English. Translation resources are retained for future releases.
faq.10.a: Email support@congregationassistant.com. Do not send congregation records in your first message.
footer.independent: Independent and unofficial. Not affiliated with any religious organization.
